item.title: Adult brain shows greater self-repair capacity
item.description: New research in mice reveals a special support cell group that may enhance the adult brain's ability to repair itself.

item.title: Ozempic may reveal brain's hidden craving center
item.description: Ozempic-like drugs may reduce cravings for alcohol and other substances, hinting at a brain region linked to desire.

item.title: Starlink satellites repurposed to probe Earth's upper atmosphere
item.description: Researchers have devised a novel method to map a challenging region of Earth's upper atmosphere, using orbital data from Starlink satellites.

item.title: Ancient skeletons from Vietnam may rewrite syphilis history
item.description: 3,500-year-old remains suggest diseases like yaws could have been transmitted from mother to child, a mode often overlooked in ancient populations.
